Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
Question that has risen on the Discord (and has been answered, I only need an RD confirmation here for future reference):

Do all non-X equipment cost 1 less or is it only the equipment you unlock after equipping that cost 1 less. “Those equipment cards” has an ambiguous antecedent.
A vampire with Vast Wealth fetching a Kevlar Vest: does he get the reduction from the Museum? (not equipping from hand) A vampire fetches a Flak Jacket, benefits from Museum, pays zero, unlocks, fetches a Kevlar Vest. Do they benefit from the reduction again? (not benefiting from unlock)
(I know it's both yes, discussion isn't needed, just an RD confirmation for the record)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> lip wrote:
> Question that has risen on the Discord (and has been answered, I only need an RD confirmation here for future reference):
>
> Do all non-X equipment cost 1 less or is it only the equipment you unlock after equipping that cost 1 less. “Those equipment cards” has an ambiguous antecedent.
> A vampire with Vast Wealth fetching a Kevlar Vest: does he get the reduction from the Museum? (not equipping from hand) A vampire fetches a Flak Jacket, benefits from Museum, pays zero, unlocks, fetches a Kevlar Vest. Do they benefit from the reduction again? (not benefiting from unlock)
> (I know it's both yes, discussion isn't needed, just an RD confirmation for the record)
>
Clarification:

Unique location.
+1 hand size. Minions you control can unlock after resolution of a successful action to equip with a non-electronic, non-vehicle, non-weapon equipment card from your hand; a minion can unlock only once this way each turn. {Non-electronic, non-vehicle, non-weapon} equipment cards cost minions you control -1 blood or pool to equip.

So yes to both questions.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
